verdict.rationale: Reflect's docs confirm note history with continuous edit recording and reverting a note to any prior point in time, directly matching the version-history/restore part of the story. However, there's no evidence specifically addressing recovery of deleted notes (only note-level version reversion is documented), and no independent/hands-on corroboration of this feature. Missing for 10: explicit deleted-note recovery/trash mechanism, and community or hands-on verification of the history/restore feature working reliably.
